rv.q: There is merriment in the confusion and its untangling, but also a dream-like instability in a punchy, satisfying show.
Painlessly cut and played at a cracking pace, this production validates Twelfth Night ‘s position as the finest of Shakespeare’s comedies.
Jamie Glover’s production has moments of magical promise
Great acting, and a magnificent comedy.
This is a hugely entertaining production and showcases the talent and versatility of this fine company of actors.
Jamie Glover's Twelfth Night has a great pace to it, with the humour of the second act driving a glorious and vibrant evening.
It’s a production that oozes energy and flair.
Twelfth Night was funny and also heartfelt, it did exactly what it was meant to, but I feel that it could have given more richness and warmth.
Whilst it’s not a particularly creative production, it will give you a few laughs on these dark autumnal evenings.
